participant_tool_errors: Recoverable only while the same declared participant budget remains; preserve trusted error evidence
delivery_gate: Host must establish exact observation delivery, available permitted interface, fresh isolated case context and valid source custody before any participant failure can become abstention
attribution: Only trusted host/provider evidence, never a model-declared reason; ambiguous failures invalidate the paired run
raw_evidence: Host retains complete original response/error artifacts; this pure mapper checks supplied content bindings but performs no storage or custody authentication
budget: One caller-authenticated immutable prospective budget hash per case; host enforces exact limits and attributes exhaustion
retry: No reset, terminal replacement, label-informed retry or case reselection; permitted within-case analysis stays inside the original budget
complete_run: Any invalid case prevents a scored paired run; trusted complete prediction records still undergo the unchanged strict transport and scorer validation
